errors.evidence: The x-axis labels range from 2016 to 2024. While the data extends slightly beyond the last tick mark, stating the time range goes up to 2025 is an extrapolation not explicitly supported by the axis labels.
The final value for the black line ("Wirtschaftspolitik insgesamt") on the left axis is approximately 650, not 'über 800' (over 800).
The final value for the light blue line ("Finanzpolitik") on the left axis is approximately 600, not 'über 700' (over 700).
The purple line ("Handelspolitik") uses the right y-axis (scale 0 to 9,000). Its peak around 2020 is at approximately 200, not 2,000. This is an error by an order of magnitude.
